name: Sex & Friend ~Osananajimi no Amai Nioi~
original_name: セックス＆フレンド ～幼馴染の甘い匂い～
source:
Masaki had known Mitsuru Ebina since they were little. The rumor at school was that they were going out. But in reality, they were always at each other's throats. Even so...Mitsuru was getting prettier each year, and Masaki couldn't help but notice. Then one day she came to give him a love letter one of the other girls had asked her to give him. Masaki had mixed feelings, but Mitsuru was as blunt as ever. And then he told her how he felt...

[From [url=http://www.hgamez.net/]HgameZ.net[/url]]
translation:
正树从小就认识海老名光。学校里一直流传着两人正在交往的传闻，但实际上，他们见面总免不了拌嘴。即便如此…光一年比一年漂亮，正树也无法不去注意她。一天，光替另一个女孩给他送来一封情书。正树心情复杂，光却还是一如既往地直来直去。于是，他向她说出了自己的感受…
